crossRefs.note: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
Do good, Yahweh, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.
If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness…
For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.
Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
